notes: Socket identifiers and enum values were read from bpy in Blender 4.5.14 LTS.

Grid Vertices X/Y values below 2 still produce vertices when the other axis is positive. Only a 0 on either axis evaluated to a mesh with 0 vertices. The 4.5 manual sentence about 'smaller than two' is not used as an emptiness predicate.
Points Count 0 evaluated to 0 vertices after GeometryNodePointsToVertices. Count 1 and Count 4 matched the vertex count.
Mesh Line Count 0 with count_mode TOTAL evaluated to 0 vertices.
ShaderNodeMath DIVIDE enables sockets Value and Value_001. Value_001 is the divisor.
A VALUE output linked to a VECTOR input was is_valid true. An INT output linked to a VALUE input was is_valid true. A GEOMETRY output linked to a VALUE input was is_valid false.

Named Attribute has a Name input and no domain property. Store Named Attribute stores a domain enum. The 4.5 attributes manual documents automatic domain interpolation, so a custom attribute stored on a different domain from its consumer is not reported as an error.
The attributes manual states that the domain of a built-in attribute cannot be changed, and that position is the point-domain built-in.
Simulation and repeat zones were created with pair_with_output. Cycles that contain both ends of a pair are zone feedback, not generic illegal cycles.
Realize Instances inputs in this build are Geometry, Selection, Realize All, and Depth. The 4.5 manual warns that performance can become much worse with many instances.

empty_generators.evidence: Blender 4.5.14 evaluation: Vertices (0,0), (0,3) yield 0 vertices. Vertices (1,1) yields 1 vertex and (1,2) yields 2 vertices, so values of 1 are not reported.
Blender 4.5.14 evaluation through GeometryNodePointsToVertices: Count 0 yields 0 vertices, Count 1 yields 1, Count 4 yields 4.

empty_generators.message: Mesh Line Count is 0 in Total mode
empty_generators.evidence: Blender 4.5.14 evaluation with count_mode TOTAL: Count 0 yields 0 vertices, Count 1 yields 1, Count 2 yields 2.

expensive_nodes.reason: The Blender 4.5 manual says performance can become much worse when Realize Instances runs on many instances of complex geometry.
